design.advance: For each final profile and history separately, add useful locations on at least three source photos across two families, add at most two ordinary source groups and at most four misplaced edited files. Direct delivery must be assessed separately from edits staged over an earlier JPEG.
design.comparison: Keep aligned luma finding if selected. Try local history gap on files with no baseline region. Record ungated geometry, candidate alone and combined outcomes on the same final bytes.
design.points: Per final profile, strict exceedance of the second-largest source maximum on all ordinary calibration images, with a minimum of 0.24. Positives are evaluated only on other sources.
design.scope: Exact native pre-delivery change against the corresponding base; experimental rectangle is visible compression-history evidence with zero AI authorship weight.
